preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10**5 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s must have a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if all(is_palindrome(s + 'a') for s in test_cases) else 'YES'
postconditions.description: If all possible strings formed by inserting 'a' are palindromes, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: any(s + 'a' != s[::-1] for s in test_cases)
postconditions.description: If there exists at least one string formed by inserting 'a' that is not a palindrome, output 'YES'.
If output is 'YES', the constructed string must have a length of |s| + 1.
